answer: Funding provenance tracing stops farms at the inlet where their money enters. First, the ledger records which address paid each new account's join fee. Second, it walks that payment back up to three hops. Third, accounts that share one source get a single combined reward cap of 50 POA per epoch. Fourth, the cap stays until each wallet earns 30 days of separate history. A farmer with 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 clean funding paths, about $2 of exchange fees and KYC each, or $2,000, plus a month of waiting. Sybils are like bees hauling nectar home to one hive; follow the comet tail of trips.
